title: Spectral constants for the quantum annulus
summary: We find several new estimates for the spectral constants $K(\mathbb A_r)$ for which a closed annulus $\overline{\mathbb A}_r$ or closed polyannulus $\overline{\mathbb A}^n_r$ is a $K$-spectral set for operators in the quantum annulus $\mathbb Q \mathbb A_r$. We give two alternative proofs to an existing estimate of spectral constant. The first proof capitalizes a dilation theorem due to McCullough and Pascoe, while the second proof involves a certain variety in the Euclidean biball.
